lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A semi-regular grid of high-luminance circular clusters is visible posterior to the branchial slits, arranged in approximately four vertical columns with 3-4 local maxima per column.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Subtle vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance blobs, forming grid-like anchor nodes along the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal linear feature is visible across the upper flank, exhibiting a sharp vertical gradient with light pixels on the dorsal side and shadow-induced low intensity on the ventral side.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately 6-8 high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, showing a less regular distribution than those on the main flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor linear markings and small depigmented patches are visible along the leading edge of the dorsal fin and upper flank region.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple elongated, low-luminance objects (remoras) are clustered around the pectoral fin and along the ventral boundary of the shark.
